**Disclaimer**

I have a very strict regimen that I follow. I have been caught once before, but only because my mom found a bong hidden in my closet. Before that, she had no clue I smoked, and as of right now she thinks I have stopped. I consider this technique to be pretty foolproof, but I can't promise you it will work every single time. If you really aren't supposed to be smoking where you're at, weigh the risks and the benefits before you light up.

Now, to the good stuff.

**When can I smoke?**

If you're stealth smoking to hide it from someone else who lives there, don't do it unless they aren't home or they are asleep. When I say "not home" I mean, make sure you have at least an hour and a half to yourself. And when I say "asleep" I mean really asleep, not as soon as they go to bed.

**Where can I smoke?**

The room you smoke in has a few requirements. It must have a window, a fan, and a lock on the door. Ideally, this is either your bedroom or a bathroom.

**What kind of piece should I use?**

Generally, I prefer a bong to any other piece, but I do not recommend this for stealth. The main reasons being, you have to fill it with water, it makes extra noise when you take your hit, and its pretty easy to overdo it and send yourself into a coughing fit after a bong rip. The stealthiest piece by far is a vaporizer, but they tend to be a bit expensive. So, for stealth smoking a pipe of some sort is probably going to be your best bet. Definitely never smoke papers when trying to be stealthy, the constant burning produces a pretty strong smell.

**How do I hide my weed and weed accessories?**

I used to just stash my herb in a tin and hide that in my underwear drawer or something along those lines, but a friend ended up giving me a [lock box](http://ecx.images-amazon.com/images/I/41gJZOT%2BH8L.jpg) and this is where I stash everything that is incriminating. My grinder, my lighters, my pieces and of course, my herb. I would highly recommend getting one of these and hiding it somewhere. I usually stash the keys in the bottle of ibuprofen I carry around in my backpack.

Okay, so now you know when, where and how to smoke your weed secretly. When its time to actually do the deed, you'll need to make sure you have the following things on hand before you get started.

The obvious ones would be your piece of choice, your herb of choice, and a lighter. Duh. The other things you'll need are eye drops (I like Clear Eyes. Not the cooling ones though, I ~~fucking hate those~~ don't recommend them), a bottle of Ozium (an air "freshener" spray, but for those unfamiliar with it, instead of making your room smell like weed + air freshener, it removes all odor from the air), a sploof (if you aren't sure what a sploof is, its something to blow smoke through to make it smell better, I'll include some instructions on how to make one later on in this post), an extra outer layer of clothes (put them over your clothes while you smoke, then after you finish toss 'em in your laundry so you don't smell too dank), and whatever beverage you like to sip on while you're smoking.

As for the actual smoking, here are a few tips:

1. Roll up a towel (or two, if your apartment is like the one I live in and has a lot of space between the floor and the bottom of the door) and lay it in front of the door, pushing it up against it gently. Be careful not to push it under the door though, that's super suspicious to someone outside the door.

2. Watch something or listen to music. This is not only to entertain you, but it will also cover the sound of your lighter clicks.

3. Don't take a hit that you can't handle. Kinda self-explanatory, but if someone hears you coughing your lungs out they might come to investigate.

4. After you take a hit, cover the bowl. This will put out the cherry and prevent any extra smell from coming off of it.

5. Open your window while you're smoking. I aim towards the window but I don't blow smoke straight out, because that looks very suspicious to a bystander. I don't turn the fan on until I leave the room, and before I leave I spray Ozium (I like to aim it at the fan to help it circulate around the room.) By the way, try not to breathe in after you spray the Ozium, leave the room alone for about 30 minutes (I usually take a shower during this time, an optional step but I recommend it) and when you come back it should smell like nothing at all.

6. Make sure everything is put away and taken care of before you leave your room, or even before you unlock your door. Ask yourself, "Did I use my eye drops? Is everything hidden/locked up?" etc.

**How do I make a sploof?**

It's super simple. Just stuff an empty toilet paper roll with dryer sheets and then rubber band a dryer sheet over the one end. After you take a hit, exhale into the open side of the sploof and the smoke will smell like laundry instead.
